Tab. 12.16 Zusammenstellung der Eingabedaten für die Endlagerung hoch und mittelaktiver Abfälle (BE/HAA/LMA)
reason: Tab. 12.14 (p.342) gives the input data for the INFRASTRUCTURE of the geological repository for high- and intermediate-level waste — the BE/HAA/LMA repository, i.e. spent fuel, vitrified high-level waste and long-lived intermediate-level waste, which is exactly this 1 p infrastructure dataset with its excavation, backfill materials, energy and transports. Tab. 12.13 on p.341 is the same for the short-lived low/intermediate (SMA) repository and is in range only because the two tables adjoin; Tab. 12.16 (p.343) is the disposal service that uses this infrastructure.
